subject: Flumph

subject: Thorin

source_quote: Everybody we come across here in the Underdark has tried to kill us, so we are wary.

subject: Flumph
fact: The Flumph is known as a flumph because it makes a flumph sound when it moves.
source_quote: I am known as a flumph. Or at least that’s what others call us because we make a flumph sound when we move.

subject: Flumph
fact: The Flumph feeds on the psychic energy of creatures, not parasitically like Mind Flayers, but on residual background energies.
source_quote: I am a flumph. And my kind feeds on the psychic energy of creatures. We aren’t parasitic like the Mind Flayers; we feed on the residual background energies.

subject: Flumph
fact: The Flumph says evildoers are typically torturing, abusing, feeding, or doing other horrible things.
source_quote: Well, the evildoers are typically torturing, abusing, feeding, or doing other horrible things.

subject: Zalthir

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes Bahamut is the god of good dragons and that chromatic dragons are not inherently evil.
source_quote: Bahamut is the god of good dragons. He is committed to the principle that dragons have free will and that the pigmentation of their scales doesn’t pre-determine their personality. This idea that chromatic dragons are evil is the greatest evil.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz began mentally composing journal entries as a habit since his escape from Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Daz, a thoughtful magician and long-time student of magic, was inspired by a commentator on Milo Goodbarrel's practice of writing daily... This practice became a regular habit since his escape from Velkynvelve.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes: 'Gartokkar wants proof of the involvement in demonic worship. Bring me the statue of Demogorgon.'
source_quote: Gartokkar - "I want proof of the involvement in demonic worship. Bring me the statue of Demogorgon."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes: 'He intended to use the proof of the theft and the proof of the demonic worship to convince the Deepking that it was time to eliminate the scourge of the Derro from the city.'
source_quote: He was planning to engage in a genocidal war against the Derro.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes: 'Gartokkar was not against paying for a service—“2000.”'
source_quote: Gartokkar - "2000."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes: 'We secured an upfront payment of 30% of the 2000 gold. Then we secured a confidentiality rider worth another 1000 gold.'
source_quote: We secured an upfront payment of 30% of the 2000 gold. Then we secured a confidentiality rider worth another 1000 gold.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz writes: 'If you betray me, there is no cave, no pool of still water, no river, no place in the dark that I will not find you and hunt you down.'
source_quote: If you betray me, there is no cave, no pool of still water, no river, no place in the dark that I will not find you and hunt you down.
